Cc: Acuity Audit <audit@eu-auditors.com>
Subject: Bridge letter timing — are 'as-of' timestamps inclusive for 2024 Q4?

Hi Priya,

We're preparing our regulator package and want to include a short bridge letter for Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covering Oct 1 2024 — Dec 31 2024. Our compliance team is asking a specific question: when your report references the audit period end, is the intent that 'as-of' timestamps are inclusive through 23:59:59 on the last day (UTC), or does the auditor treat the period as ending at 00:00 on the same date (i.e., exclusive)?

Concretely, can you confirm whether the bridge letter can state "as of 2024-12-31 23:59 UTC" for point-in-time evidence (logs, snapshots)? Also, we need a manifest of retained logs for the last day (UTC timestamps) to pair with the bridge.

Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday so we can finalize our package?

Thanks,

Jon Smith
Head of Security Programs
Finex Payments

Subject: Re: Bridge letter timing — are 'as-of' timestamps inclusive for 2024 Q4?

Priya / Marissa — short answer: our Type II testing used inclusive end-of-day coverage. The auditor's point-in-time checks were performed against data that include events through 2024-12-31 23:59:59 UTC. That said, auditors usually prefer the bridge letter to say something like:

"Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report covers the period October 1, 2024 through December 31, 2024. For the purposes of point-in-time evidence, the auditor's testing included events on December 31, 2024 up to 23:59:59 UTC. Any bridge statement is subject to the auditor's review and signature."

Notes / actions:
- We should route the final wording to Acuity Audit for explicit sign-off — I'll loop them in (cc included).
- Compliance can generate a per-service log manifest for 2024-12-31 in CSV (example columns: service, path, start_utc, end_utc, sample_count). I asked infra to export; provisional filename: log_manifest_2024Q4.csv (attached).
- I'll attach a draft bridge letter (bridge_letter_proposal.pdf) for Acuity to edit/approve.

If Acuity is okay with the phrasing we'll provide the signed letter + manifest to Finex.

—Karthik
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and next steps: we can provide a bridge letter that references the end of the audit period using an inclusive "as of" timestamp. Proposed working language (subject to Acuity Audit sign-off):

"Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report covers the period October 1, 2024 through December 31, 2024. For point-in-time evidence, the auditor's testing included events occurring on December 31, 2024 up to 23:59:59 UTC. This bridge statement will be finalized and signed by the independent auditor (Acuity Audit)."

We've attached two items for your package: redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf (our draft template for auditor review) and log_manifest_2024Q4.csv (per-service manifest for Dec 31 2024, UTC ranges included).

Next steps for Finex: please confirm the timezone (UTC is fine for us) and whether the regulator requires millisecond precision or if seconds-level is acceptable. Once you confirm, we'll route the proposed wording to Acuity Audit and request a signed letter; target turnaround is 48–72 hours from auditor acceptance.
